title: Sum
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Operations/Matrix_Sum.md
Deep Learning Toolbox/Shallow Neural Networks/Net Input Functions/netsum.md
text: Add or subtract inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {List of signs} sets Operations performed on inputs; {Apply over} sets how to apply function along specified dimensions All, {Dimension}, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the output data type, {Accumulator data type} sets the data type of the accumulator, {Require all inputs to have the same data type} requires that all inputs have the same data, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.
